failure.stopped: The Gozler service is stopped, so Gozler cannot search. Start it, and Gozler searches again by itself.
failure.disabled: The Gozler service is turned off, so Gozler cannot search. Turn it on, and Gozler searches again by itself.
failure.not_installed: The Gozler service is not installed, so Gozler cannot search. Install it, and Gozler searches again by itself.
failure.missing: Gozler is not fully installed: the Gozler service is missing. Download Gozler and run its setup.
failure.unknown: The Gozler service is not running, and Gozler could not find out why: {0} Check the Gozler service in Services.
failure.not_ready: The Gozler service is starting. Your search runs when it is ready.
failure.not_gozler: The search service is not the Gozler service, so Gozler did not connect. Restart Windows, so that the Gozler service starts first, then search again.
failure.too_old: The installed Gozler service is older than this window. Download Gozler and run its setup to update the service.
failure.refused:
The Gozler service refused this search. Change the search, then try again.

query.no_query_start: Gozler could not read the date in this search. Search again.
query.too_many_terms: The search has {0} terms, more than Gozler can search at once. Remove some terms.
query.too_many_regexes: The search has {0} regular expressions, more than Gozler can search at once. Remove some of them.
query.misplaced_not: ! must start a term. Put a space before it, or put it in quotation marks to search for it.
query.not_without_term: ! needs a term after it, such as !draft.
query.or_without_terms: | needs a term on each side, such as pdf|docx.
query.operator_on_nothing: {0} tests nothing, so ! and | cannot apply to it. Remove the ! or the |.
query.size: {0} is not a size. Use a size such as size:large or size:1mb..10mb.
query.reversed_dates: {0} runs backwards. Write the earlier date first, such as dm:2026-01-01..2026-03-31.
query.date_out_of_range: {0} is outside the dates Gozler can search. Use a date such as dm:2026-01-31.
query.days: {0} needs a number of days above 0, such as dm:7days.
query.date: {0} is not a date. Use a date such as dm:today, dm:yesterday or dm:2026-01-31.
query.no_parent_folder: parent: needs a folder, such as parent:C:\Users\Public.
query.attribute_letter: {0} is not an attribute letter. Use letters such as attrib:h for hidden items, or press F1 for every letter.
